title: Photo-Review Claims on Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Photo-review claims on Cartwise Grocery Orders

## Intake standard

A damaged or quality issue on a line charged above the photo-required threshold of the order's service level is not refunded by the agent while no photo is on the case; the customer submits it as their own photo-review claim with `request_type` `photo_review`, asking for the photo-review claim amount this rule computes, and the review team decides it. This rule prices a photo-review claim on a line sold by weight, that is an item line in the weighted item class.

A photo-review claim on a line sold by weight is not registered until any weight-overage refund owed on that line stands on the order. A photo-review claim is registered only after the service-fee share owed for the item refunds already standing on the order has been returned as a fee refund.

Both conditions are states of the order's entries: any weight-overage refund owed on the claimed line is already standing on the order, and the service-fee share owed for the item refunds already standing is already among the order's fee refunds, when the claim is registered.

## Points of judgement

- The standard reaches damaged and quality issues only, on a line whose charge is above the service level's photo-required threshold; a line charged exactly at that threshold is not above it.
- The claim is the customer's own submission; while no photo is on the case, the agent does not refund the issue.
- The claim asks for an amount; the review team decides it, and nothing is refunded when the claim is registered.

## Claim tool: `submit_photo_review_claim_a5aac31c`

**Capability.** With this tool the customer submits, from their own Cartwise account, their claim that an item on one line of a grocery order arrived damaged or spoiled, for the refund review team to decide on a line whose charge is too high for the support desk to refund without a photo on the case. One call registers one review request for the named order line with the review type "photo review", the requested amount and the status "submitted"; nothing is refunded by the call and the order's billed amount does not change. The customer sees the claim at once among the order's review requests, stamped with the current time, and it stays submitted until the review team approves or denies it.

**Invocation.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs `submit_photo_review_claim_a5aac31c`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | The customer reference number of the claimant's own profile, handed over by the support agent from the customer profile lookup | Id |
| `order_id` | The order number of the grocery order the claim concerns, handed over by the support agent from the order lookup | Id |
| `line_number` | The position of the claimed item line on the order, exactly as shown on the billed line entry | Integer (1, 2, 3 ...), no decimals |
| `refund_reason` | The controlled reason of the claim | Exactly one of the literals listed below |
| `requested_amount_usd` | The amount the claim asks the review team for | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never 0 or negative |

Values of `refund_reason`:

- `missing` — the billed product never reached the customer;
- `damaged` — the product arrived broken, crushed or leaking;
- `wrong_item` — a different product from the one ordered or approved was handed over;
- `quality` — the product arrived spoiled, off-smelling, expired or otherwise unfit.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `order_review_request_id` (the reference number of the new claim), `order_id`, `line_number`, `refund_reason`, `request_type` (always `photo_review`), `requested_amount_usd` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `request_status` ("submitted" when the claim now waits for the review team).
